data.name: Kashifa
data.gender_notes: Kashifa is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic word 'kasha'fa, meaning 'to give light'. This name is derived from the Quranic verse 'Allah is the Light of the heavens and the earth.' (24:35). The name Kashifa carries the meaning “Light-giver” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Kashifa usually hope their child will grow to embody light-giver and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Signifying the light of Allah's guidance and wisdom
data.etymology: Kashifa belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Light-giver.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kashifa total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: كاشفة
in_arabic.meaning: الاسم يعني من تكشف عن شيء وتظهره
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم كاشفة مشتق من الفعل كشف، وهو يعني من تكشف عن شيء وتظهره. هذا الاسم له أهمية كبيرة في الثقافة الإسلامية، حيث يرتبط بالمعاني الروحية والكشف عن الحقائق. في اللغة العربية، الكشف يعني إظهار الشيء المخفي أو المجهول، ومن هنا فإن اسم كاشفة يعبر عن الشخص الذي يمتلك القدرة على كشف الحقائق وإظهار الحقيقة.

in_urdu.name: کاشفہ
in_urdu.meaning: نام کا مطلب ہے جو کچھ چھپا ہوا ہے اس کو ظاہر کرنا
in_urdu.long_meaning: کاشفہ نام عربی زبان کے الفاظ سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے جو کچھ چھپا ہوا ہے اس کو ظاہر کرنا۔ یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں اہمیت رکھتا ہے، خاص طور پر جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں میں۔ اس نام کا روحانی مطلب ہے کسی خفیہ یا پوشیدہ چیز کو ظاہر کرنے کی صلاحیت، جو اسلامی تقالید میں ایک قابل ذکر صفت ہے۔

in_hindi.name: काशिफा
in_hindi.meaning: नाम का अर्थ है जो छुपा हुआ है उसे प्रकट करना
in_hindi.long_meaning: काशिफा नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी भाषा से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है जो कुछ छुपा हुआ है उसे प्रकट करना। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में महत्वपूर्ण है, जहां यह नाम आध्यात्मिक और धार्मिक महत्व रखता है। इस नाम का अर्थ है किसी छुपी हुई या गुप्त बात को उजागर करने की क्षमता, जो इस्लामी परंपरा में एक महत्वपूर्ण विशेषता है।

in_pashto.name: کاشفه
in_pashto.meaning: دغه نوم د چاڼلو معنا لري، هغه څه چې پټ دي ښکاره کول
in_pashto.long_meaning: کاشفه نوم د پښتو ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې د چاڼلو او ښکاره کولو معنی لري. دا نوم د افغانستان او پښتونستان په سیمه کې د مسلمانانو لپاره مهم دی، چیرته چې دا نوم د روحاني او مذهبي ارزښتونو سره تړاو لري. د کاشفه نوم معنی دا ده چې کوم پټ یا نه معلومه شوی څه ښکاره کول، کوم چې د پښتون او اسلامي کلتورونو لپاره ځانګړی اهمیت لري.

in_english.name: Kashifa
in_english.meaning: One who reveals or discloses hidden things
in_english.long_meaning: The name Kashifa originates from the Arabic root 'kashafa,' which means to reveal or disclose. In Islamic tradition, Kashifa is a name given to someone who has the ability to uncover hidden truths or reveal concealed information. This name holds significant spiritual and cultural importance across various Muslim communities worldwide. It symbolizes the attribute of insight and the ability to bring clarity to obscure matters. Historically, names like Kashifa were chosen for their beautiful meanings and positive connotations, reflecting the values and aspirations of the community.

data.cultural_impact: The name Kashifa holds deep significance in Islamic culture, particularly associated with scholars and intellectual figures. In various monographs, the title Kashifa or Kitab Kashifa (Book of Revelation) is given to important works in Islamic religious, philosophical, and hadith literature. The name signifies the role of knowledge as a light that reveals truth and guides individuals towards spiritual growth and enlightenment.
data.spiritual_significance: Beyond its cultural associations, the name Kashifa also holds profound spiritual significance in Islam. As derived from the Quranic verse, this name underscores Allah's role as the ultimate source of wisdom and guidance. It reinforces the idea that knowledge is a manifestation of Allah's divine light and can be harnessed to deepen one's understanding of the divine and lead a virtuous life. Thus, Kashifa serves as a reminder of the transformative power of knowledge and its role in both the temporal and spiritual aspects of life.
